blocks.content: This step is optional. Use Segments when you own one named segment, or when Overview can no longer turn auto-apply on because it is already on for every segment. Skip it when only the Default segment exists and you already turned auto-apply on for it. Select **Coverage-first** or **Cost-first** in the edit dialog. These are the same modes as on Overview.

1. Open **Adaptive Metrics**.
1. Open **Segments**.
1. Click **Edit segment**, or **Edit default segment** for Default.
1. Select **Enable auto-apply**.
1. Select an **Auto-apply mode**.
1. Click **Apply** for the Default segment, or **Save** for a named segment.

The Segments list shows whether auto-apply is on for that segment.

You can also turn auto-apply on when you add a segment. Refer to [Configure segmentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/additional-configuration/adaptive-metrics-rule-segmentation/) when you want to add one.
